This is by no means a big grill, but I've cooked for parties of 15 on this grill. I live in a house of 6 people and grill regurarly and this grill can handle virtually anything.

If I could change one thing however, the grate isn't my favorite. Our old spirit's grate I thought was better designed this this one. The bars on the old grate were angled to a point and reduced the amount of surface area your food is touching on the grate. I would cook lots of fish on it and nothing ever stuck to it. The bars on the grate on this grill are almost flat and food gets stuck on it more frequently if you're not careful enough with cooking spray.

Other than that, the size, performance, assembly, and price of this grill is hard to beat.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first propane grill. So far, I love it. The two-burner setup is the perfect size for me and my wife. Easy to use and clean ('cuz my wife takes care of both!). Starts right up, the regulators for the burners seem to be predictable enough to achieve repeatable temperature levels at given settings (how accurate the temperature gauge is has yet to be scientifically determined, but just having a gauge sure is cool), the little rack that sits above the grills in back is a nice touch, and the two-sided grills themselves are quite functional. My only complaint, and it's not really a complaint, more of a tip derived from observation, is that you have to sort of bounce the propane tank a little bit to get an accurate (and I use the term "accurate" loosely; I feel more comfortable knowing I have a spare tank on hand, although, when I think about it, we're still on our first tank, and we bought the grill a couple of months ago and use it at least three times a week) reading of how much propane is left in the tank.

Results.ReviewText:
This is an amazing little grill.  It is perfect for my wife and I with the occasional group over for dinner.  We have already used an entire tank of propane between grilling and slow smoking a pork shoulder.  (It's not designed as a smoker, but a small woodchip box over the flavorizer bars works ok)
The only suggestion I would make is the design of weighted pressure gauge system.  There are little nubs which hold the tank out away from side of the unit, but they are too short.  The rim of the tank sits on the wheel axle.  This creates an inaccurate measurement.  The numbs also catch in the label of the tank...causing further issues.

I'm still giving the grill a 5-star rating.  It heats well with only minor hot/cold spots.  Far superior to any previous grill.  Might have opted for the 3 burner model, though, as the grill can get a little crowded with veggies, burgers, hotdogs and such when we have company.  But 90% of the time the size is perfect.
Results.Title: Great grill with one minor flaw...

Results.ReviewText:
Nicely built/designed grill.  Like most weber products it should last.   Reasons for only 4 stars:
1) The hooks for hanging utensils are inadequate and have very little value.  Had to build a different system for hanging utensils on left hand wing..  Need deep S hooks
2) The left hand wing is collapsible.  Great. However when extended it is designed to be the "tote" for rolling the grill around, and the flanged nuts which carry the entire load during movement are subject to rotation and eventual rip of the tear-holes in left wing.
3) The temp gauge formed condensation first few days and was could not be read.  But my real issue was mailing tech support twice with no response.

Hopefully someone in QA will read these comments and make course corrections to improve future customer experience
Results.Title: Will last but engineers need to use design

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was skeptical about the assembly when we ordered the grill through the Navy Exchange. It arrived on-time and so the process began.  Everything, every nut, bolt and washer was labeled is separate bag for the step I was about to perform,  Amazing.  The best part for me was to see the total quality of every piece.  The fit and finish is remarkable. It took a little over an hour as I did this in the sun on our patio which included a "beer break."  Once O connect the gas bottle securely to the very cool scale, I followed the direction of "cooking-it-in" before my first use.  We are so pleased with the time and taste this grill provides.  Clean-up  is a snap.  I also like the available accessories and replacement parts on your website--BRAVO!  This is our first Weber grill and I am impressed.  Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: From Assembly to Table-That's the Spirit!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
